description: True-stereo capture sessions for tools/stereo_capture.py, one game launch per location, from the main menu with the default character (no save). Frame numbers follow the Mac bench scenarios on the M1 (main menu by 300, Whiterun loaded by about 1500, Riverwood by about 2100); check each location's centre shots and adjust. Console input is typed with tools/bench/bench.py's typer: one command per console opening, since keys typed within about 1.5 s of a Return are dropped (observed), so multi-command steps go through `bat` files placed in the game folder. The weapon is drawn (R) before `sgtm 0.02` slows the world to 2 %, so the draw animation finishes first. `tm` hides the HUD, which would otherwise sit at the same place in both true eyes. Crops are normalized [x, y, w, h] rectangles of the frame (top-left origin), for tools/stereo_compare.py.
